_comment: Auto-complete entries for the Method column on the Dimensions page.
This is a SUGGESTION list, not a validation list. Anything typed is kept,
matched or not: a one-off gage pulled off the shelf must still be
recordable without editing a file first, or the list becomes a reason to
Order is the order shown when the list opens on an empty field, so the
things reached for hourly sit at the top and the specialised ones sit
below. Filtering re-ranks: entries that START with what was typed come
before entries that merely contain it.
Hand-edited for now. Edit > Methods... will own this file later; keep the
shape to a flat array of plain strings so that editor stays trivial.
Storage is Unicode like everything else (PLAN.md 3). Write a real diameter
sign if one is ever needed, never a font slot.
